items.title: Closed sets are stable under specialization, open sets under generalization, and the two stabilities are complementary
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the interaction of the specialization relation with closed and open subsets (author lemma at source lines 3784-3794, label lemma-open-closed-specialization): closed sets are stable under specialization, open sets under generalization, and the two stabilities are exchanged by complementation. The proof (source lines 3796-3809) is short and direct: part (1) is the containment of the closure of a singleton in a closed set, part (3) is the reversal of the relation for the complement, and part (2) is their combination (proof lines 3797-3808). The lemma is the reference point for the chapter's later results on constructible sets and on spectral spaces, where specialization-stability is used constantly. H2.
